categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Touches wallet key and descriptor management in `src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp` and carries the `Wallet` label.
categories.rationale: Replacing `DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan`'s public recursive mutex with a private non-recursive lock clarifies lock hierarchies and avoids potential re-entrancy deadlocks during availability notifications. While it improves internal locking discipline and stability (part of issue #19303), it is primarily an internal refactoring without an active bug report, making review reasonably deferrable.
